description: The full dated price series for ONE product or vendor (by slug), plus derived stats: first-tracked date, current/low/high, number of recorded changes, net %, the largest single move, and the last change. A change is counted only between two consecutive price-scan readings of the same site; low, high and net % are measured over those readings, since comparableSince where a correction of ours or a change of the source the price is read off cut the series, and no move is counted across such a cut or from a figure our record wrote without a reading. It answers 'how much did X cost', 'did X's price drop' and price-trend questions from the recorded series. Returns found:false (never a fabricated series) for an unknown slug.

kind.description: Limit to 'hw' (hardware product) or 'sw' (software vendor). Omit to match either; a slug is resolved across both.
